{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2024",
    "lib": ["ES2024", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "strict": true,
    "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "verbatimModuleSyntax": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "types": ["vite/client"],
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": true,
    "paths": {
      "@/*": ["./*"]
    }
  },
  "include": [
    ".",
    "../api/types.ts",
    "../api/paths.ts",
    "../schema/types.ts",
    "../schema/hunk-meta.ts",
    "../schema/blame-runs.ts",
    "../schema/image.ts",
    "../schema/image-diff.ts"
  ],
  "exclude": ["**/*.test.ts"]
}
